name: lp2
exec: (()=>{const T=window.THREE,S=window.__app.scene;const o=[];for(const x of [-79,-80,-82,-84,-86,-88]){const rc=new T.Raycaster(new T.Vector3(x,1.6,9.4),new T.Vector3(0,1,0));const h=rc.intersectObjects(S.children,true).filter(v=>v.object.name.startsWith('main'));o.push('x'+x+' UP: '+(h[0]?h[0].object.name.replace('main:','')+'@y'+h[0].point.y.toFixed(2):'SKY'));}const rc2=new T.Raycaster(new T.Vector3(-86,1.6,9.4),new T.Vector3(0,-1,0));const h2=rc2.intersectObjects(S.children,true).filter(v=>v.object.name.startsWith('main'));o.push('DOWN: '+(h2[0]?h2[0].object.name.replace('main:','')+'@y'+h2[0].point.y.toFixed(2):'void'));return JSON.stringify(o)})()
